versions.changelog: Seven-token liquidation radar onboarding with one free call per token per UTC day, then 0.001 USDC; six-tool manifest and independent execution workflows.

- Clarified that the skill now covers only market-data tools (manifest + liq radar) and explicitly excludes fund movement and swaps.
- Updated documentation to make it clear swap/bridging functionality is out of scope and should be handled by the related hypernatt-terminal skill.
- Revised the description and usage instructions to emphasize market-data-only functionality and remove references to order execution or custody.
- Updated tool list and tags to match the focused, read-only market-data scope.
- Improved clarity and precision in the documentation on when and how to use the skill.

- Initial release of hypernatt-liq-radar skill for OpenClaw/Hermes agents.
- Instructs agents to call remote HyperNatt MCP's get_liq_radar (liquidation map) before sizing any crypto perp trade (BTC, ETH, SOL, others).
- Skill is strictly read-only, with no local execution or file access; only remote MCP tool calls over HTTPS.
- Exposes exactly 3 MCP tools: get_agent_manifest (free), get_liq_radar (paid, $0.001 USDC/x402), and swap_via_nattswap.
- No trade execution or custody functions; does not give trade advice or claim performance.
